record.question: The cottage nestled ______ woodland on one side and pasture land on the other.
record.explanation: Answer D: between. Between links the cottage with the two distinct flanking areas named: woodland on one side and pasture on the other (D). Independent check: “Between woodland on one side and pasture land on the other” explicitly identifies the two boundaries. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/between-or-among. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
